name: General / Standard Subtitles
description: Balanced standard subtitle translation prompt for general videos.

name: Chinese → Vietnamese: Urban / Modern / Workplace
description: Workplace hierarchy (sếp, tổng tài, quản lý), family, modern romance. Avoids wuxia diction.

name: Chinese → Vietnamese: Wuxia / Xianxia / Historical
description: Martial arts & cultivation terminology (giang hồ, sư phụ, chưởng môn, tại hạ, đan điền, linh khí).

name: Chinese → Vietnamese: Short Drama / Douyin / Comedy
description: Fast-paced punchy dialogue, dramatic turns, high-impact reactions, concise subtitle cues.

name: Japanese → Vietnamese: Anime / School / Slice of Life
description: Romaji names (Tanaka Taro, NO Hán-Việt), honorifics (~san, ~kun, ~chan, ~senpai, ~sensei), polite keigo.

name: Japanese → Vietnamese: Isekai / Fantasy / Action
description: Romaji names, fantasy adventure terms (dũng giả, ma vương, guild mạo hiểm giả, chiêu thức kỹ năng).

name: Korean → Vietnamese: K-Drama / Modern / Romance
description: Latin/Romaji names (Kim Soo-hyun, NO Hán-Việt), formal 존댓말 (kính ngữ + ạ) vs casual 반말, sunbae/oppa/unnie.

name: Korean → Vietnamese: Hunter / Dungeon / Manhwa
description: Action RPG terms (thợ săn, hầm ngục, cổng gate, người thức tỉnh, bang hội guild, chỉ số status).

name: English → Vietnamese: Vlog / Social Media / TikTok
description: Engaging creator voice (mình - các bạn), conversational, punchy, concise phrasing for video.

name: English → Vietnamese: Movies / Casual Dialogue
description: Dynamic natural address forms for I/You depending on character age, rank, and intimacy.

name: English → Vietnamese: Documentary / Tech / Business
description: Formal, authoritative, precise terminology, neutral address (tôi - quý vị / các bạn), objective tone.
